findings.evidence: The Motley Fool collects information about our readers so that we can provide a more interesting and useful service, as well as more appropriate advertising. We ask for your name, email address, and other personal information when you register to use certain features of our Web site, or if you sign up for special or personalized services, such as our discussion boards or email newsletters. We also may ask for this information at other times, such as when you enter contests or other promotions sponsored by The Motley Fool and/or our partners. We sometimes conduct surveys as well, although you do not have to respond to them.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly state that they collect IP addresses or device IDs, but it mentions collecting other personal information, which could include these data types.
The policy explicitly states multiple purposes for which cookies and web beacons are used, thus specifying a purpose.
The policy specifies collecting IP addresses for site security and improving user experience, thus indicating a purpose.
